findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe multiprocessing in s3transfer
 * @description Potential security issues with multiprocessing and untrusted data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-multiprocessing
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-668
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("multiprocessing").getMember(["Process", "Pool", "Queue", "Pipe", "Manager"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("concurrent.futures").getMember(["ProcessPoolExecutor"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential security issue with multiprocessing and untrusted data."
findings.hypothesis: Multiprocessing used with untrusted data could lead to security issues
